teaser: You set the phone down mid-sentence, the argument still unfinished in your mouth, because something in the room just turned sadder than the debate was worth. That pause is the crossing: life path 9 and ENTP in one person. The 9 asks for a long unclenching, a letting go of outcomes, a care that reaches past any one person toward everyone. ENTP wants an open field of ideas, every angle worth a sentence, every premise worth testing. In you, generosity gets argued into shape before it is offered, and the argument gets softened by something larger it serves.
